definitions.name: Z2A.GL
definitions.note: SCAN step for run length: acc m -> (acc+1)*m, m a 0/1 flag

definitions.name: Z2A.OREV
definitions.body: 'Z2A.OR' BIND [ 'price' ] [ 0 ] RECORD Z2A.OR MERGE 'price' GET Z2A.OR 'qty' GET MUL
definitions.note: Order Record -> qty times price, 0 when it has no price

definitions.name: Z2A.REVENUE
definitions.body: JSON-DECODE 'orders' GET [ Z2A.OREV ] MAP 0 [ ADD ] FOLD
definitions.note: Orders JSON String -> total qty*price over priced orders

definitions.name: Z2A.QTYREC

definitions.note: Orders JSON String -> Record sku -> summed qty, first-appearance order

definitions.name: Z2A.OTAGS
definitions.body: 'Z2A.OT' BIND [ 'tags' ] [ [ ] ] RECORD Z2A.OT MERGE 'tags' GET UNIQUE
definitions.note: Order Record -> its distinct tags ([ ] when it has none)

definitions.name: Z2A.WORDS
definitions.note: String -> Vector of its space-separated non-empty words

definitions.name: Z2A.JOINSP

definitions.name: Z2A.CAP
definitions.body: LOWER CHARS 'Z2A.CC' BIND Z2A.CC 0 GET UPPER Z2A.CC 1 DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
definitions.note: Word -> first letter upper case, rest lower case
